- [ASSISTANT_SAID] The ankh is composed of a cross with a loop at the top and symbolizes the union of male and female principles.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] The ankh was used in religion, art, daily life, and was closely associated with pharaonic power.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] The ankh was often depicted in various contexts, including amulets and jewelry for protection and good fortune.
